competitors.name: TradingView
competitors.description: Charting and social trading platform with technical indicators and community-built strategy scripts.
complaints: Real-time data and most useful indicators are locked behind a paywall
Pine Script has a steep learning curve for anyone without a coding background
Alert system is unreliable during high-volatility market opens
No built-in predictive modeling, just charting and manual technical analysis

competitors.name: Yahoo Finance
competitors.description: Free financial news, data, and portfolio tracking platform.
complaints: Data is often delayed 15-20 minutes, useless for active trading decisions
App is cluttered with ads and unrelated news content
No predictive or forward-looking analysis, purely historical/reporting
Portfolio sync with brokerages breaks constantly

competitors.name: Seeking Alpha
competitors.description: Investment research platform combining crowd-sourced analysis with quant ratings.
complaints: Aggressive paywall after the first article each month
Quant ratings are a black box with no visible methodology
Comment sections are dominated by low-quality, biased takes on individual stocks
Premium subscription renews automatically and is hard to cancel

competitors.name: Robinhood
competitors.description: Commission-free retail trading and investing app.
complaints: No real analytical or predictive tools, just a bare-bones order execution UI
Order flow practices and outage history during volatile days damaged user trust
Customer support is nearly impossible to reach for account issues
Gamified UI encourages impulsive trading rather than informed decisions

competitor_variants.name: Webull
competitor_variants.description: Retail trading app with paper trading and basic technical indicators.
complaints: Technical indicators are present but no predictive/forecasting layer at all
Customer support response times are frequently reported as slow

competitor_variants.name: Stock Rover
competitor_variants.description: Fundamental research and screening platform for long-term investors.
complaints: Focused entirely on fundamentals, no short-term price prediction capability
Interface feels dated compared to newer trading tools

competitor_variants.name: Trade Ideas
competitor_variants.description: AI-assisted stock scanning and alert tool for day traders.
complaints: Very expensive for retail users at $100+/month
AI 'Holly' bot recommendations are opaque with no explainability

raw_complaint_pool: Existing tools show you data but never actually tell you what's likely to happen next.
Real-time predictive signals are locked behind $50-100/month subscriptions.
Most 'AI stock prediction' apps are black boxes with zero explainability into why a signal fired.
Backtesting tools are separate paid products from the actual trading/alerts tools.
No unified tool combines news sentiment, technicals, and prediction confidence in one view.
Retail investors get last access to signals that institutional quant funds already priced in.
Mobile apps for active trading are laggy exactly when markets are moving fastest.
Free tiers are crippled to the point of being unusable for real decision-making.
complaint_pool_extended: Predictive accuracy claims are never independently verifiable or backtested transparently.
Alerts fire too late to actually act on the underlying price movement.
Cross-asset coverage (stocks + crypto + options) is fragmented across multiple apps.
Onboarding assumes financial literacy most retail users don't have.
trend_signals: Retail interest in AI-driven trading signal tools grew sharply through 2025-2026 amid broader retail AI adoption.
Regulatory scrutiny of 'AI stock prediction' marketing claims has increased, raising the bar for transparent methodology.
